results.name: Flood in Brandenbourg, Germany
results.reason: Due to heavy rainfall in Middle and Eastern Europe, flooding is forecast to affect Brandenburg rivers in an area bordering Poland (Neisse and Oder). The flooding is expected on the 14 and 15 September 2024. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide flood extent emergency mapping.
